meta.description: LoRA on Krea 2 (raw) with quantization + low_vram for 24GB cards. Natural-language captions. For Krea 2 Turbo, switch the arch to krea2:turbo in the UI so the training adapter is applied. Speed (2026-08-29): latents are served from RAM after the first pass (cache_latents + cache_latents_to_disk — disk-only caching re-read every latent every step), loss_sync_every 4, ui_db_poll_seconds 2. Training math unchanged. STEP TABLE (meta.step_table, 2026-10-12, machine-independent - the same table ships on every krea2 preset, laptop or desktop): 20 images ~1500, 30 images ~1800, 50 images ~2500, 75 images ~3000, exact-count interpolation between rows, capped at 3000 steps. OPTIMIZED DATASET COUNT ~75 images: that is where the cap is reached; past it the panel keeps 3000 and the exposure gauge says the dataset is past the optimal size for this model and suggests curating down, instead of calling it undertrained. Source: the Krea 2 community table (20 ~1500 / 30 ~1800 / 50 ~2500 / 100 ~3500, gathered 2026-10-11 and shipped first in krea2_5090_char_lora), capped at 3000 so the 50-100 segment stops at 75 images. Values are steps at effective batch 1; the Step Suggestion panel divides by your effective batch (batch_size x gradient_accumulation), which is the only thing that differs between machines. Below the first row the first row's steps apply.
